The [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Jhaka Bakarn]] led a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] '''squadron''' in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] several generations before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Bakarn led her squadron to glory against a [[Unidentified warlord (Jhaka Bakarn)|warlord]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], though she [[Death/Legends|died]] in the final assault.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bakarn's squadron was first mentioned in the Codex entry for the Bakvalen family in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
